# Check that the reader endpoint exists
GET _inference/_all

# Extract text from an image URL (the filter returns only the Markdown)
POST _inference/document_extraction/.jina-reader?filter_path=document_extraction.content
{
  "input": [
    {
      "content": {
        "type": "image",
        "format": "url",
        "value": "https://images.openfoodfacts.org/images/products/807/680/952/3547/nutrition_de.380.full.jpg"
      }
    }
  ],
  "task_settings": { "parameters": { "preset": "ocr" } }
}

# Extract text from a base64 image
POST _inference/document_extraction/.jina-reader?filter_path=document_extraction.content
{
  "input": [
    { "content": { "type": "image", "format": "base64", "value": "data:image/png;base64," } }
  ],
  "task_settings": { "parameters": { "preset": "ocr" } }
}

# Create an index with a semantic_text field (default embedding model on Serverless)
PUT food_labels_demo
{
  "mappings": {
    "properties": {
      "product_name": { "type": "text" },
      "language":     { "type": "keyword" },
      "source_url":   { "type": "keyword" },
      "content":      { "type": "text", "copy_to": "meaning" },
      "meaning":      { "type": "semantic_text" }
    }
  }
}

# Index three extracted labels (German, French, English)
PUT food_labels_demo/_doc/pesto-de?refresh=true
{
  "product_name": "Pesto Rosso 200g",
  "language": "de",
  "source_url": "https://images.openfoodfacts.org/images/products/807/680/952/3547/nutrition_de.380.full.jpg",
  "content": "# Nährwertdeklaration\n\n|  | g | 100 |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| Energie | kJ | 1360 |\n|  | kcal | 329 |\n| Fett | g | 29 |\n| davon: gesättigte |\n| Fettsäuren | g | 3,4 |\n| Kohlenhydrate | g | 12 |\n| davon: Zucker | g | 7,8 |\n| Ballaststoffe | g | 2,3 |\n| Eiweiß | -g | 3,8 |\n| Salz | g | 2,8 |\n\n## GLUTENFREI\n\nBarilla G. e R. Fratelli - Società per Azioni, Via Mantova 166, 43122 Parma (Italien).\n\n[www.barilla.com](http://www.barilla.com/)"
}

PUT food_labels_demo/_doc/fromage-fr?refresh=true
{
  "product_name": "Fromage Blanc Nature",
  "language": "fr",
  "source_url": "https://images.openfoodfacts.org/images/products/611/124/672/1261/nutrition_fr.139.full.jpg",
  "content": "# Code Couleur & Nutri-Score\n\nD'après ses valeurs (159 kcal et 11g de lipides), ce produit se situerait probablement en :\n\n- **Nutri-Score : C**\n- **Code Couleur : Jaune / Orange clair**\n\nPourquoi ? Bien qu'il soit \"nature\", sa teneur élevée en **matières grasses** (11g) et l'ajout d'amidon et d'épaississants font monter l'apport calorique par rapport à un fromage blanc classique à 3% de MG (qui tourne autour de 70-80 kcal)."
}

PUT food_labels_demo/_doc/chocolat-en?refresh=true
{
  "product_name": "Excellence Noir Prodigieux 90% Cacao",
  "language": "en",
  "source_url": "https://images.openfoodfacts.org/images/products/304/692/002/9759/nutrition_en.546.full.jpg",
  "content": "| NUTRITION INFORMATION PER 100g: |\n| --- |\n| Energi / Energiaa / Energi / Energi / Wartość energetyczna | 2483 kJ / 592 kcal |\n| Fett / Rasvaa / Fedt / Fett / Tłuszcz | 55 g |\n| - varav mättat fett / josta tyydyttynyttä rasvaa / heraf mættede fedtsyrer / hvorav mettet fett / w tym kwasy tłuszczowe nasycone | 30 g |\n| Kolhydrater/ Hiilihydraattia / Kulhydrater / Karbohydrater / Węglowodany | 14 g |\n| - varav sockerarter / josta sokereita / heraf sukkerarter / hvorav sukkerarter / w tym cukry | 7,0 g |\n| Protein / Proteiinia / Protein / Protein / Białko | 10 g |\n| Salt / Suolaa / Salt / Salt / Sól | 0,03 g |\n\nQUALITY GUARANTEE CHOCOLADEFABRIKEN LINDT & SPRONGLI AG\n\nDistribueras av / Markkinoija /"
}

# Show the embedding model the semantic_text field resolved to
GET food_labels_demo/_mapping

# Search by words: no label contains "sugar", so no hits
POST food_labels_demo/_search
{
  "query": { "match": { "content": "sugar" } },
  "_source": ["product_name", "language"]
}

# Search by words: matches the German label
POST food_labels_demo/_search
{
  "query": { "match": { "content": "Zucker" } },
  "_source": ["product_name", "language"]
}

# Search by meaning: ranks every label by closeness, so compare the scores
POST food_labels_demo/_search
{
  "query": { "semantic": { "field": "meaning", "query": "fresh dairy cheese" } },
  "_source": ["product_name", "language"]
}

# Search by meaning: a second query
POST food_labels_demo/_search
{
  "query": { "semantic": { "field": "meaning", "query": "dark chocolate high in fat" } },
  "_source": ["product_name", "language"]
}

# ES|QL: labels per language
POST _query?format=txt
{
  "query": "FROM food_labels_demo | STATS labels = COUNT(*) BY language | SORT language"
}

# ES|QL: semantic match
POST _query?format=txt
{
  "query": "FROM food_labels_demo METADATA _score | WHERE MATCH(meaning, \"fresh dairy cheese\") | SORT _score DESC | KEEP product_name, language, _score | LIMIT 3"
}

# Delete the demo index
DELETE food_labels_demo
